notes: Cog-WM LHMM with Cog-Harness v3 achieved 65.16% success (1629/2500) on RoboCasa365. The evaluated system combines a frozen Xiaomi-Robotics-1 one-epoch Human300 SFT policy, GPT-6 Astra medium planning and a Harness memory system with task-scoped frozen experience, episode working memory, auditable retrieval and adaptive execution scheduling. The data pipeline aligns native state/action semantics, synchronized camera history, validity masks and exact effective batches. Live task-progress predicates and object truth coordinates were removed; native depth and terminal-only feedback were retained. The PR also describes the separate BCP/RPM policy design and the report's Future-all offline future-feature prediction objective; the score is not attributed to Future-all.
